name: Pranati Behera / ପ୍ରଣତି ବେହେରା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pranati Behera’s three Odia poems in Kabita Live move between public injustice, private exhaustion and a wish for freedom. In “ସେମାନେ ମଣିଷ ନ ଥିଲେ”, people reduced to voting identities lose the power to question those who govern them. The poem’s bitter final turn makes protest an expression of being human.

“ପୋଡା ସଳିତା” brings illness, office demands and domestic responsibility into the image of a burning wick. “ମଧୁମୟ” opens another possibility: a river allowed its own rhythm, an uncaged bird and a morning entering a freshly prepared courtyard. Read together, these poems ask what allows a life to breathe, at home and in the wider world.
